what: Per producing seat: the window (min_h..max_h, hours) a state it reports can plausibly move an MT5 price over, its decay half-life, and the session it is released into. Read by libs/mining/source_horizon.py in the miner compiler's expand_axes: a chart outside the window is DEMOTED in queue order (never dropped), and every session cell of a source with a release_session is labelled own/transfer. Declared priors, to be revised by measured decay; a row may override any key. A seat absent here reads UNDECLARED, never INSIDE. kind=strategy marks a strategy record, whose horizon lives in its own params.
